Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at Middle East?

In the A-26 schedule, 37 stations broadcast aimed at Middle East. The most heavily scheduled include BBC, China Radio International, VoA Radio Ashna, Radio Farda.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at Middle East?

The most-used frequencies are 9370, 15595, 11575, 15520, 12030 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
